boundaries: Actual production standalone Next.js UI, verified TLS, private Valkey and real Chromium; LDAP inline credentials, Keycloak ID-token/UserInfo and synthetic OAuth.
Provider setup is fixture-driven for #197; actual administrator configuration/verification/activation remains #198.
UI fixtures schedule upstream eligibility every 30 seconds and explicitly wait past due renewal after browser decisions; separate server protocol fixtures retain five-second stress coverage.

Concurrent OIDC tabs approve one exact mutation and deny the other; terminal errors may be delivered to the original operation form or remain in the approval dialog depending on callback/poll ordering.
No real GitHub native-client, whole #581 or #582/main/stable acceptance is claimed.
limitations: OAuth fresh credential approval remains explicitly unsupported; local recovery stays available.
Candidate receipts bind the initiating token and must be recreated/tested after rotation.
Uncertain protected operation results require inspection and never replay automatically.
Protected browser flows require the server public origin and exact frontend return registration.
